description: Reviewed rules with their conditions, provenance and remaining limits.

detail.scope: Selected reviewed rules, with their original authority, conditions and limits. This is not an exhaustive mechanics guide.

name: Research & progression

rule_views.conditions: Organized Labor II; Town Hall 10; free Major capacity; 1400 RP for rank I.
rule_views.limits: Prerequisites directly read on the card on 18 September; no purchase.
rule_views.title: Documented research prerequisite

rule_views.conditions: English card read by Codex on 18 September 2026: Material Salvage II; Town Hall 10; Major research capacity; 1400 RP for rank I.
rule_views.limits: Explicit rank-I prerequisites; no purchase. Higher-rank building requirements not separately tested.
rule_views.title: Documented research prerequisite

rule_views.conditions: Required Minor=Focus Production; the other requirements on the card also apply.
rule_views.limits: Explicit prerequisite text reported by Claude; not a new Codex observation.

rule_views.conditions: English card read by Codex on 18 September 2026: Queue Planning II; Town Hall 10; Major research capacity; 1400 RP for rank I.

rule_views.conditions: Required Minor=Loaded Caravans; the other requirements on the card also apply.

rule_views.conditions: Required Minor=Campaign Orders; the other requirements on the card also apply.

rule_views.conditions: Developer Wynfir answers mrgbg about troops sent between own villages; screenshot received 18 September 2026. Displayed times 16:26 and 16:28, message date/timezone not visible.
rule_views.limits: Developer confirms the merging capability only. Cost, precise prerequisites, troop eligibility and inherited upgrades are not specified by this screenshot; consult separately sourced research effects.
rule_views.statement: The Consolidated Legions research Keystone enables troops to be merged into another village you own.
rule_views.title: Merging troops between owned villages

rule_views.conditions: Direct English UI reading by Codex on 18 September 2026. Research > Economy > Reset Research. No reset or corrective action.
rule_views.limits: Observed UI availability only. Does not establish backend timer scope or trigger symmetry. Remaining 63h is not the initial cooldown duration; earlier evidence records 72h.
rule_views.statement: Individual and All reset controls were both explicitly disabled while the panel displayed a remaining cooldown.
rule_views.title: Reset controls during cooldown

rule_views.conditions: Direct English UI reading by Codex on 18 September 2026. Research > Economy > Reset Research. No reset or corrective action.
rule_views.limits: Displayed prerequisite, not an instruction to act. No cooldown line shown in this village; absence and inconsistent secondary enabled-state checks are insufficient to prove timer scope or reset availability.
rule_views.statement: In another village the panel displayed: Downgrade or cancel production enhancers above level 5 before resetting.
rule_views.title: Research reset building prerequisite

rule_views.conditions: First +1 Major capacity purchase; Town Hall >=15 observed historically. First three prices later stated by Wynfir on18September.
rule_views.limits: First price corroborated by developer. Next prices recorded separately; no purchase. Values may change next server.
rule_views.title: First Major capacity purchase

rule_views.conditions: First +1 Minor capacity purchase; Town Hall >=10 observed historically. First three prices later stated by Wynfir on18September.
rule_views.limits: First price corroborated by developer. Next prices recorded separately; no purchase. Values may change next server.
rule_views.title: First Minor capacity purchase

rule_views.conditions: French interface read on 18 September 2026; original proof context and limitations apply. English editorial translation, not a new observation.
rule_views.limits: Allocation of the 3 ranks was not tested; do not generalise a Town Hall requirement to all Keystone technologies.
rule_views.statement: Expedition Camp 20; 16000 RP; Keystone capacity; any 3 Major ranks in this branch.
rule_views.title: Frontier Command prerequisites

rule_views.conditions: Frontier Command card: Expedition Camp 20, Keystone capacity, 16000 RP and any 3 Major ranks in this branch.
rule_views.limits: Card effect only; no purchase or direct observation of four occupied sites.
rule_views.title: Frontier Command additional slot

rule_views.conditions: Reset panel displays a 72-hour cooldown; Jeremy confirms waiting between repeated resets.
rule_views.limits: Both reset buttons directly observed disabled while a remaining cooldown was shown. Scope across technologies/villages and whether both modes always start the same timer remain unverified; second village had a different prerequisite. No reset performed.
rule_views.title: Research reset cooldown
